observation_schema.advisory: four elements held with the command for six ticks: turn_sense is the sign of the spin to turn with, +1 counterclockwise and -1 clockwise, 0 for the motor's own choice; the rest are zero
observation_schema.arrival: relative velocity within 1 for thirty complete intervals, with spin within 0.2 at a zero-speed command and within 0.5 otherwise; no heading requirement; retention judges velocity only
observation_schema.frame: the planet frame the physical brake decelerates toward: its point velocity at the ship origin
observation_schema.heading: world radians; forward=(-sin(heading),cos(heading))
observation_schema.speed: nonnegative COM speed along the command heading relative to the pilot's planet frame at the ship origin, up to 60
